description: This Scala source file defines the ExecutorPodsSnapshot class and companion object, which provide an immutable view of current executor pods in a Kubernetes cluster for Apache Spark. It includes methods for updating pod states, filtering based on pod phases, and handling container exit codes.

classes.name: ExecutorPodsSnapshot
classes.description: An immutable snapshot of executor pods with methods to update and interpret pod states.

methods.name: withUpdate
methods.description: Returns a new snapshot with an updated pod.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Factory methods to create snapshots from pod sequences or empty.

methods.name: setShouldCheckAllContainers
methods.description: Configures whether to check all containers for exit codes.

methods.name: setSparkContainerName
methods.description: Sets the name of the Spark container to look for in pods.

methods.name: toStatesByExecutorId
methods.description: Converts a sequence of pods into a map of executor IDs to pod states.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Determines the state of a pod based on its status and phase.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if a pod is considered deleted based on its metadata and status.
